title: Israel's Netanyahu trailing in polls
gist: An Al-Monitor Middle East Minute podcast summary reporting that Israeli PM Netanyahu is trailing in polls, that Iran is signaling openness to diplomacy, and that Israel is frustrated with the Hezbollah disarmament process in Lebanon.

insights.claim: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu is trailing in polls, according to an Al-Monitor Middle East Minute episode.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Netanyahu slipping in polls signals potential Israeli political change to monitor for shifts in security and diplomatic posture.

insights.claim: Iran is signaling it is open to diplomacy.

insights.so_what: Iranian openness to diplomacy is a de-escalation signal relevant to energy and Gulf risk amid the ongoing conflict.
